name: @xpert-ai/plugin-story-studio
description: Agentic story adaptation studio for scoped projects, reviewable production planning, and media handoff workflows.

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-build-output.mjs && pnpm run build:ui && node scripts/build-remote-components.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs && node scripts/build-sandbox-action.mjs && node scripts/verify-sandbox-action.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm run build:ui && jest --config jest.config.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.spec.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.remote.json --noEmit && node scripts/build-remote-components.mjs --check && node scripts/build-sandbox-action.mjs && node scripts/verify-sandbox-action.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build:ui && node scripts/build-remote-components.mjs --check && node --test src/lib/remote-components/story-studio-workbench/workbench.e2e.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:ui && tsc -p tsconfig.spec.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.remote.json --noEmit && node scripts/build-remote-components.mjs --check
